project_summary: Mobile banking API with OAuth 2.0 authentication and PSD2 compliance

components.name: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend
components.description: Implementation of OAuth 2.0 flows (authorization code, refresh token) with JWT-based session management, multi-tenant token isolation, and rate limiting per client.

components.name: PSD2 open banking consent management
components.description: Consent lifecycle for third-party providers: creation, 90-day renewal, revocation, and a strong customer authentication challenge for every account-information request.

components.name: Transaction history and categorization API
components.description: Paginated transaction history endpoints with server-side filtering by date and amount, and rule-based categorization of merchants.

components.name: Push notification service for payment alerts
components.description: Delivers push notifications through FCM and APNs when a payment is received or a card is blocked, with per-user notification preferences.

project_summary: Payment orchestration platform with multi-acquirer routing and settlement reporting

components.name: Acquirer routing engine
components.description: Rule engine that chooses the acquirer for each payment by card scheme, currency, amount and acquirer success rate, with automatic failover when an acquirer times out.

components.name: Webhook delivery with retries and signing
components.description: Outbound webhooks to merchants with HMAC signatures, exponential retry for 48 hours and a replay endpoint for failed deliveries.

components.name: Daily settlement reconciliation job
components.description: Nightly job that matches acquirer settlement files against internal ledger entries and flags missing, duplicated or mismatched payments.

components.name: Merchant dashboard with settlement reports
components.description: React dashboard where merchants browse payments, download settlement reports as CSV and manage API keys.

project_summary: Online loan origination portal with credit scoring integration

components.name: KYC document upload and verification workflow
components.description: Applicants upload identity documents and proof of income; an automated OCR step extracts the data and sends doubtful cases to a manual review queue for analysts.

components.name: Credit scoring service integration
components.description: Integration with two credit bureau APIs, normalization of the returned scores and a configurable decision rule that approves, rejects or refers an application.

components.name: E-signature and contract generation
components.description: Generates the loan contract as a PDF from a template and sends it for qualified electronic signature through a third-party provider.

project_summary: Internal ledger modernization: database migration, regulatory reporting and audit trail

components.name: Legacy ledger database migration
components.description: Migrate the general ledger from MySQL 5.7 to PostgreSQL using logical replication and a cut-over window under five minutes, with row-level checksums to verify the copy.

components.name: Regulatory reporting export
components.description: Monthly regulatory reports generated as CSV and XBRL files from ledger balances, with a validation step against the supervisor's schema.

components.name: Immutable audit trail for ledger changes
components.description: Append-only audit log of every ledger change with user, timestamp and before/after values, protected against tampering with hash chaining.

project_summary: Headless e-commerce storefront for a ceramics brand with Stripe checkout

components.name: Server-rendered storefront and product search
components.description: Next.js storefront with server-side rendering for category and product pages, image optimization and a typo-tolerant product search.

components.name: Stripe checkout and payment intents flow
components.description: Checkout with Stripe payment intents, 3D Secure handling, saved cards for returning customers and webhook-based order confirmation.

components.name: Persistent cart and promo code engine
components.description: Cart that survives across devices for logged-in users and a promo code engine supporting percentage, fixed-amount and free-shipping rules with usage limits.

components.name: SEO and structured data
components.description: Schema.org product markup, XML sitemaps, canonical URLs and redirects for the legacy catalogue URLs.

project_summary: Fashion marketplace with multi-vendor catalogue and vendor payouts

components.name: Vendor onboarding and catalogue import
components.description: Self-service vendor onboarding with bank-account verification and bulk product import from CSV files, including image download and validation errors per row.

components.name: Faceted product search
components.description: Elasticsearch-based search with facets for size, colour, brand and price, synonyms for fashion terms and ranking boosts for in-stock items.

components.name: Order splitting and vendor payouts
components.description: Splits a customer order into one sub-order per vendor, tracks shipment per vendor and pays vendors weekly through Stripe Connect, net of commission.

project_summary: Grocery delivery app with delivery slot booking and warehouse integration

components.name: Delivery slot booking with capacity limits
components.description: Customers choose a one-hour delivery slot; capacity per zone and per slot is enforced and slots are held for ten minutes during checkout.

components.name: Real-time inventory sync with the warehouse system
components.description: Two-way synchronization of stock levels with the warehouse management system every minute, with substitution suggestions when an item runs out.

components.name: Driver mobile app with route assignment
components.description: Mobile app for drivers showing the assigned route, delivery proof by photo and signature, and live position updates to the customer.

project_summary: Product recommendations and email marketing automation for an electronics retailer

components.name: Collaborative filtering recommendation widget
components.description: Batch-trained item-to-item collaborative filtering model served through an API, with a recommendation widget on product and cart pages and a popularity fallback for new visitors.

components.name: Mailchimp audience sync and abandoned cart emails
components.description: Hourly sync of customer segments to Mailchimp and a three-step abandoned cart email flow triggered from cart events.

components.name: A/B testing framework for storefront banners
components.description: Server-side experiment assignment, event tracking and a simple results page with conversion rate and significance for homepage banner variants.

project_summary: Patient portal with appointment booking and HL7 FHIR integration for a private clinic network

components.name: Patient portal with secure login and appointment booking
components.description: Patients sign in with two-factor authentication, see upcoming visits and book, move or cancel appointments with their doctor according to the clinic calendars.

components.name: HL7 FHIR integration with the hospital EHR
components.description: Reads and writes patients, appointments and lab observations through the hospital's HL7 FHIR R4 API, with mapping tables between clinic codes and FHIR resources.

components.name: GDPR consent and data subject request workflows
components.description: Consent capture with versioned privacy notices, plus self-service export and deletion requests that are tracked until completed within the legal deadline.

project_summary: Telemedicine platform for video consultations, e-prescriptions and insurance billing

components.name: WebRTC video consultation with waiting room
components.description: Browser-based video consultations over WebRTC with a virtual waiting room, TURN fallback for restrictive networks and automatic reconnection when bandwidth drops.

components.name: Electronic prescription generation and pharmacy sharing
components.description: Doctors issue signed electronic prescriptions during the consultation and the patient shares them with a pharmacy through a one-time link.

components.name: Insurance billing export
components.description: Monthly export of completed consultations in each insurer's required format, with validation errors reported before submission.

project_summary: Laboratory results delivery and critical value alerting for a hospital laboratory

components.name: HL7 v2 message ingestion from lab analyzers
components.description: Listener for HL7 v2 ORU messages from the analyzers through a middleware, with parsing, deduplication and a dead-letter queue for malformed messages.

components.name: Critical value alerting via SMS and email
components.description: When a result falls outside the critical range the responsible doctor is alerted by SMS and email until someone acknowledges it, with escalation after 15 minutes.

components.name: Branded PDF result reports
components.description: Generates the patient result report as a branded PDF with reference ranges and out-of-range values highlighted.

project_summary: Mobile wellness tracking app with wearable sync and coaching

components.name: Wearable data sync from Apple Health and Google Fit
components.description: Background sync of steps, heart rate and sleep from Apple Health and Google Fit, with conflict handling when both sources report the same activity.

components.name: Goal tracking and streaks with push reminders
components.description: Users set daily goals, see progress rings and streaks, and receive smart push reminders that adapt to their usual activity times.

components.name: In-app chat with certified coaches
components.description: Real-time text chat between users and certified coaches, with attachments, read receipts and a moderation queue for reported messages.

project_summary: Factory floor monitoring dashboard fed by OPC UA sensors on rolling mill lines

components.name: OPC UA sensor ingestion gateway
components.description: Gateway that subscribes to OPC UA nodes on the PLCs, buffers readings during network outages and forwards them in order to the central platform.

components.name: Time-series storage and downsampling
components.description: TimescaleDB storage for sensor readings with continuous aggregates, retention policies and downsampling for long-range charts.

components.name: Real-time production dashboard
components.description: Live dashboard of line speed, temperature and scrap rate per rolling mill with threshold alarms and shift comparison.

project_summary: Fleet and warehouse tracking platform for a logistics operator

components.name: GPS telemetry ingestion and geofencing
components.description: Ingests GPS positions from 800 vehicles every 10 seconds, detects entry and exit from customer geofences and raises delay alerts.

components.name: Warehouse management integration via REST and SAP IDocs
components.description: Bidirectional integration with the warehouse management system: REST for orders and SAP IDocs for stock movements, with idempotent processing and replay.

components.name: KPI reports on delivery times
components.description: Scheduled reports of on-time delivery rate and dwell time per customer and route, delivered by email as PDF and Excel.

project_summary: Predictive maintenance for food packaging lines using vibration sensors

components.name: Anomaly detection model serving for vibration data
components.description: Trains an anomaly detection model on vibration spectra per machine and serves scores in near real time through a FastAPI service, with a drift monitor.

components.name: Maintenance ticket creation in Jira
components.description: Creates a Jira maintenance ticket with the machine, score and chart when an anomaly persists for three readings, avoiding duplicates for the same machine.

components.name: Edge device provisioning
components.description: Provisioning and remote update of the edge devices that read the sensors, with signed firmware images and rollback on failure.
